findings.claim: SearchPage performs external I/O directly inside a UI component, violating the acceptance criterion to preserve layered I/O.
findings.evidence: The acceptance criteria require preserving layered I/O, but the component's useEffect calls fetch(indexUrl) and stores the response directly in component state.
findings.suggested_fix: Move search-index retrieval behind the repository's service/store/hook layers and let SearchPage consume only the component-facing hook.

findings.claim: The native API parity gate can certify stale generated documentation because it only hashes sources and existing artifacts independently.
findings.evidence: collectNativeApiManifest computes separate sourceFiles and artifactFiles aggregates, while verifyNativeApiManifest merely recomputes that same object; --write can therefore bless any stale artifact/source combination. The diff changes Dart documentation in entity_graph_flutter.dart, graph.dart, and transport.dart without any corresponding generated dartdoc changes under website/static/native-api/dart.
findings.suggested_fix: Regenerate native documentation in an isolated directory during verification and compare it byte-for-byte with committed artifacts before accepting the manifest.

findings.claim: The pull-request path filter omits files that the documentation workflow directly executes or validates.
findings.evidence: The build runs docs:test:browser and test:npm-trust, but the pull_request paths omit tests/browser/v3-docs-pages*, tests/release/npm-trusted-publishing.test.mjs, and .github/workflows/publish.yml even though the npm-trust test reads publish.yml.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the documentation browser tests and snapshots, npm trusted-publishing test, and publish workflow to the pull_request path list.
